key_insight: A data-free weak-form staggered neural operator can learn coupled magneto-mechanical finite-strain responses for elastomers directly from physics constraints, without labeled FEM training data.
engineering_relevance: This enables fast surrogate modeling and solver acceleration for designing magneto-active elastomer microstructures and geometries under strong coupled loading.
method: Enforce magnetostatic and mechanical governing equations through finite-element weak-form residuals.
Train separate magnetic and mechanical neural operators with staggered alternating optimization.
Preserve coupling through constitutive relations and residual-based interaction, then use predictions to initialize Newton solves.
evidence_signal: The framework was evaluated across heterogeneous random-inclusion microstructures, varying phase contrast, area-fraction-dependent and 3D parametric geometries, including strongly out-of-distribution morphologies.
watch_item: Because training relies on weak-form physics and staggered coupling, performance may depend on residual formulation quality and stability of the alternating optimization for highly nonlinear cases.
paper_title: Data-Free Weak-Form Staggered Neural Operators for Magneto-Mechanical Coupling in Finite-Strain Elastomers
